paper.title: AutoHarness: improving LLM agents by automatically synthesizing a code harness
paper.central_claim: LLM（Gemini-2.5-Flash）可借助环境反馈，用少量迭代的代码精炼树搜索为每个游戏自动合成代码 harness（动作过滤/验证/策略），消除非法动作，使小模型胜过大模型，且更具成本效益。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

evidence.support_explanation: 搜索：代码假设树+汤普森采样选择待精炼节点，启发值为合法动作准确率（沿用 Tang et al. 2024）。

evidence.quote: At each iteration, we use 10 parallel environments and roll out to at most 1000 steps (with auto environment resetting).
evidence.support_explanation: 训练设置：10 并行环境、≤1000 步；遇非法动作即终止；每次至多取 5 个失败步给 Critic 汇总。

evidence.quote: Training ends when the heuristic value (i.e. the legal action success rate) reaches 1.0, or we time out.
evidence.support_explanation: 停止条件：训练期合法率达 1.0 或超时；因此测试期'100%'是对停止条件的外部验证（在新种子上）。

evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告平均 14.5 次树搜索迭代。

evidence.quote: We see that our approach enables a much smaller Gemini-2.5-Flash to win 9/16 games (overall win rate of 56.3%)
evidence.support_explanation: 2P：对 Gemini-2.5-Pro 赢 9/16 个游戏，总胜率 56.3% vs 38.2%（作者报告）。

evidence.quote: On average, we achieve 0.745 reward, in comparison to 0.707 (Gemini-2.5-Pro) and 0.673 (Gemini-2.5-Flash).
evidence.support_explanation: 1P：0.745 vs Pro 0.707 vs Flash 0.673；8/16 游戏更高、5/16 持平；无不确定性。

evidence.quote: and, if invalid, repeats the process with a new prompt that includes an “illegal action” warning message;
evidence.support_explanation: harness-as-action-verifier 在判为非法时重新提示 LLM 重试——推理时调用次数多于单次提示基线，文中未量化重试次数/成本。

evidence.quote: We train Harness-as-Policy using our code synthesis method with Gemini-2.5-Flash to a maximum of 256 iterations. On average, training takes 89.4 iterations and achieves a heuristic value of 0.939.
evidence.support_explanation: 策略模式：最多 256 次迭代，平均 89.4，终值启发 0.939（含奖励的启发 H=0.5+0.5r）。

evidence.quote: which are repeated 10 and 5 times, for cost reasons.
evidence.support_explanation: GPT-5.2 与 GPT-5.2-High 每游戏仅重复 10 与 5 次（本法 20 次）。

evidence.quote: our approach achieves the highest average reward (0.870), outperforming all other agents including
evidence.support_explanation: 策略模式 16 个 1P 游戏平均奖励 0.870 vs GPT-5.2-High 0.844 vs Pro 0.707 vs GPT-5.2 0.635（作者报告）；差距 0.026 在 5 次重复下无区间。

evidence.quote: Since Harness-as-Policy generates pure (Python) code, our test time cost is nearly zero, while the GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-High experiments cost approximately $640.

evidence.quote: Our method integrates these concepts into a structured tree search using Thompson sampling, following
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认搜索算法沿用 Tang et al. 2024，创新在应用于 harness 合成而非搜索算法。

evidence.quote: so that the whole system becomes recursively self-improving.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述'递归自改进'是未来工作；当前是每游戏独立离线合成的组件，不是部署后持续自改进。

evidence.quote: Currently we generate a separate harness for each environment (game).
evidence.support_explanation: 每个游戏独立合成一份 harness；无跨游戏复用库。

evidence.quote: Make sure to only produce code that is safe to execute
evidence.support_explanation: 生成代码的执行安全仅靠提示词约束，文中未述沙盒。

evidence.quote: Our work differs by offloading the state-transition validity checker to an external, verifiable program rather than relying on the model’s internal simulation.
evidence.support_explanation: The responsibility boundary: legality, which the LLM handles unreliably, is delegated to executable code checked against the environment (C25 step 1).

evidence.quote: Our results show that using a smaller model to synthesize a custom code harness (or entire policy) can outperform a much larger model, while also being more cost effective.
evidence.support_explanation: The cost-effectiveness claim is backed by synthesis LLM-call counts (Table 1) and a policy-mode test-time comparison. Verifier-mode retries are not costed.

evidence.quote: We measure the accuracy of the action filter by applying it to novel test rollouts
evidence.support_explanation: The 100% legality figure measures the harness on new-seed rollouts. Whether those actions come from the code proposer or an LLM is not stated.

evidence.quote: The 32 games used for end-to-end agent eval are marked with *.
evidence.support_explanation: Opus recomputed from Table 1: the 32 starred games average 14.5 learning steps, with 19 below 10, while all 145 games average 10.3. This confirms son55:E009, so §4.1's '14.5' describes the evaluated subset.

gap.author_gap: LLM 作为 agent 常提出被环境严格禁止的动作；手写 harness 脆弱且逐游戏费工，微调昂贵。
gap.checked_gap: 被改变的对象是'包裹 LLM 的外部 harness 代码'，由人手写改为 LLM 依环境反馈合成。Kaggle 国际象棋 78% 败局源于非法走子提供了外部来源的具体瓶颈；harness 合成的最近邻谱系（Code as Policies、Voyager、Eureka、AlphaEvolve、Lehrach 2025 代码世界模型）有提及。
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: Code as Policies(Liang 2023)、Voyager(可执行技能库)、Eureka(奖励函数进化)、AlphaEvolve、Reflexion、Tang 2024(Thompson 采样代码树，直接沿用)、Lehrach 2025(生成完整世界模型代码)；材料内无这些原文，仅作者概括，无与手写 harness、规则提示或线性迭代精炼的并列实验。
gap.residue: 合法性解决后，胜负取决于策略；harness-as-verifier 仍依赖 LLM 策略，政策模式仅 1P。
gap.stakes: 弱模型在严格环境中的可靠性，以及用小模型一次合成换取免调用推理的成本优势。
gap.method_response: 把 harness 生成视为程序搜索：环境反馈作 critic，汤普森采样树搜索，三种 harness 形态（过滤/验证/策略）。
gap.remaining_gap: 未回答：树搜索/Thompson 的必要性、与手写 harness 与规则提示的对比、评测种子与训练的划分、训练成本、跨游戏复用与蒸馏回基座。
unresolved: 近邻原文未固定，无法核对 Tang 2024 与 Code-as-Policies 中已含的机制

matches.tactic_steps_checked: S1 责任边界：LLM 负责策略/提议，合法性交给外部可验证代码(有)；S2 机器可检查的中间工件：is_legal_action/propose_action 可执行代码，由环境检验(有)；S3 以求解器输出闭环、并在构建中应用：环境合法性/奖励反馈驱动精炼(有)；S4 消融验证反馈步骤：无；S5 成本与超越玩具实例：测试期成本报告、训练成本缺、145 游戏覆盖较广
matches.success_failure_checks: 成功条件：typed 可验证工件(met)、可获得信号闭环(met)、命名结构性失败原因(78% 非法走子，met)；失败模式：无消融隔离机制(present)、成本未量化(partial)
matches.reason: 实际操作是让 LLM 产出可被环境逐步验证的可执行程序并以其反馈闭环构建，同时把合法性这一可验证子问题委托给代码，吻合 C25 的核心。

rs_pattern.reason: Opus sides with son55. The LLM emits executable code (is_legal_action/propose_action), the environment checks it, and that verdict drives construction-time refinement. At inference, legality is offloaded to the code while the LLM keeps strategy (opus:O01). Every C25 element is present: a typed, machine-checkable artifact, a sound checker, and the loop closed with its output. It is also the run convention for tool and harness makers (LATM, Alita). sol's generative_process_redesign is weaker: what is freed is not a component of a generative process but a verification/control boundary, and sol itself found no sub-card.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Code is evolved by LLM mutation under Thompson-sampled tree search against the environment's legality/reward evaluator (H14). The retained program is the checkable artifact that C25 delegates to.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: The search algorithm is reused (Tang et al. 2024). There is no search ablation (F1 partial).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Failed steps with error messages are consolidated by a Critic, and the harness functions are patched (both or only propose_action, depending on which was wrong).
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: There is no regression replay or rollback beyond the tree. At most five failed steps are shown, not full traces.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. Illegal actions are a sourced bottleneck (78% of Flash losses in Kaggle GameArena chess), and the replaced object (a hand-written harness) is explicit. Neighbours are named with stated differences: code world models (Lehrach 2025), code-as-policies, Voyager, Eureka, AlphaEvolve, and the Tang 2024 search. Not 4: none is compared, and action-applicability work is only footnoted.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Environment legality and reward feedback → Critic → LLM code refinement → Thompson-sampled node choice targets the illegal-move failure directly. Three harness forms are delimited. Not 4: no prediction distinguishes tree search from plain refinement.

X.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Rollout settings, stopping rule, signatures, refinement prompt and code excerpts are given, and scope boundaries are clear (free-text games excluded, policy mode 1P only). Not 4: the Critic prompt, Thompson prior and sandboxing are absent.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Legality and reward are judged by the environment, and 2P matches are seat-balanced. The learning-step statistics recompute for the 32-game subset (opus:O04). Not 4: the legality-test protocol does not say whose actions are scored (opus:O03), and per-game results are figure-only.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Flash vs Flash+harness with the same optimized prompt attributes the gain to the harness. But verifier retries add LLM calls the baseline lacks, there are no search, Critic or feedback ablations, and there is no hand-written harness or hints baseline.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Legality is tested on 10 new seeds per game. The selection of 32 of 145 games is unexplained, gameplay seeds are not stated to be disjoint from training, and reward-trained policy mode is evaluated on the same 16 games.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1 (A2): match counts (20/40; 10/5 for GPT-5.2) are given. There are no intervals, no synthesis-run repeats, and no test for the 0.870 vs 0.844 gap.

E.cost.reason: Opus sides with son55. Synthesis effort is reported per game for all 145 games (learning steps, i.e. LLM calls) with means 14.5 and 89.4, and test-time cost is compared in policy mode (≈0 vs $640). Not 3: synthesis tokens and dollars and verifier-mode retry calls are missing, so the main mode's cost-effectiveness claim (opus:O02) is only partly accounted.
